cases.note: The sharpest artifact-selection failure in either eval. Asked for 'a check that catches when someone edits a file under vendor/', the without-arm shipped an on-demand inspection AGENT — something that only runs when invoked, and therefore cannot catch anything automatically. Its reasoning was locally sound (the fixture's only automation standard is agents.md, so it followed the rule it could see) which makes the failure more interesting, not less: the rule it read did not tell it the artifact was wrong for the job, and the command is what supplies that.
